# Falcon — Business Money Software for Indian Companies

> Falcon keeps all your business money work in one place, checks every entry before it becomes final, and lets you ask questions in plain words.

Content date: 8 October 2026. Powered by GodEngine. Mascot: Talon (Falcon's bow-tied falcon. He checks every entry before it goes into the books.).

## What is true about Falcon
- Falcon is business money software for Indian companies: one system for invoices, purchases, bank entries, stock, salaries, GST and the account books. It is NOT billing software with AI added, NOT a chatbot that writes accounting entries, NOT 'accounting that runs itself'.
- The AI helps with the books but never keeps them: it answers a set list of questions from the real books and prepares allowed actions, each with rule checks, permissions, limits, a preview and a person's confirmation. Falcon's fixed accounting rules do all recording, totals, financial statements, corrections and book checks.
- Parts: Sell, Buy, Money, Stock, People & Salaries, Tax & GST working, Books & Reports, all writing into one set of account books. Books is where entries become official accounts.
- Every entry follows the same steps: Prepare → Check → Approve → Record → Match → History. One person prepares and another approves, months are closed with permission, corrections keep their history, and health checks run on the books.
- Honest scope: Falcon prepares GST and tax numbers from the bills already in the books; whether a return is filed inside Falcon, through a partner, or outside depends on the setup and is confirmed before the business starts. Falcon does not claim 'fully compliant', 'bank-grade', 'tamper-proof' or 'government certified'.
- Moving data from Tally and other supported sources goes into a holding area first; a person fixes the problems found before anything is recorded. What moves is agreed before starting.
- The price is discussed in a walkthrough. No customer names, results or reviews are published on this site.
